title: Broken Ridges
description: Just a minecraft mod aiming to add machines and much more to minecraft.
body:
![Lead Alloy used to make Armour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88697795e145ba41e189c520e949ecd163028c85.png)This mod is centered around adding machines to minceraft, sort of like Create. Broken Ridges was heavily inspired by Create and Create: Northstar. If you have suggestions please wait as I will make a discord soon. Until then enjoy this early mod and I will continue updating it.

Broken Ridges is a mod developed by Venovee aiming to add multiple new materials and machines to not only enhance the vanilla gameplay experience but to add to it too. This mod is actively being worked on and all versions will be uploaded to the versions repository. This mod is actively in development and not ready for a full release so bugs will be expected. This mod currently runs on the Fabric mod loader with the exception of the first mod file. Fabric 1.21.8 and the required Fabric API are required to play this mod. With that being said, the mod is currently playable, enjoy!

Join the mod's discord! - https://discord.gg/endWjrKdjN
